_doc: T-416 (2026-11-20): the pre-declared universe of the daily options snapshot archive (scripts/archive_options_snapshots.py). Owner approval 2026-11-20: start saving free daily option prices and implied volatility, so the project builds its own options history going forward (no free history with quotes exists). Every field below is read by the archiver; changing the list changes the coverage denominator, so review the diff.

_rules.expiries: Listed expiries strictly after the snapshot date, within horizon_days. Weekly = the LAST listed expiry of each calendar week (Friday, or Thursday when Friday is a holiday), so Mon-Thu dailies are skipped. Take the first n_weekly weeks, then the next n_monthly weeks that contain a third Friday (the standard monthly).
_rules.strikes: Strikes within +/- strike_band of the reference price (the underlying's delayed-SIP latest trade; for an index, the declared proxy). Only the standard root (root == symbol) is kept.
_rules.real_quote: quote stamped on the snapshot's ET session date AND (bid > 0 OR a last trade > 0 stamped that session) AND 0 < ask, bid <= ask <= no-arbitrage bound (reference price for a call, strike for a put) AND (implied vol finite and > 0, unless iv_expected is false).
_rules.coverage: An underlying is covered when it has >= min_real_per_underlying real-quote contracts. Covered / declared < coverage_floor -> FAILED (rows that came back are kept). Zero real quotes in total -> FAILED and nothing written.

_universe_rationale: Index exposure: SPY, QQQ, IWM (the census's index-premium family O-1) plus XSP, the mini-SPX index option (European, cash-settled, Section 1256), which is the vehicle O-1 names and whose retail spreads are the binding unknown. Single names: 45 of the largest S&P 500 companies, all with weekly options, drawn from the 117 names that already have an earnings calendar in data/earnings/ so the earnings-options family E-1 can use this record. Picked by size and option liquidity with a sector spread; BRK.B is left out because its option root (BRKB) differs from its stock symbol.

_excluded.SPX: Served on the indicative feed, but carries no implied vol or greeks (Alpaca has no index level), and the SPX root is the AM-settled monthly: its quotes on 2026-11-20 were stamped 2026-11-19 (it stops trading the day before expiry). XSP covers the same index at a retail size.
_excluded.SPXW: Served (quotes fresh on 2026-11-20) but no implied vol or greeks; 10x XSP's notional, beyond the owner's size; ~13k contracts in 60 days within the band, which would more than double the daily bytes.
_excluded.opra: The OPRA feed returns HTTP 403 'OPRA agreement is not signed' on this account (2026-11-20); only the indicative feed is free.
